Find reads with close competing bins

Source: R/result-analysis.R
ambiguous_reads.Rd

Returns reads for which the second-smallest finite distance is within margin of the smallest distance. In hierarchical results, distances to bins outside the read's parent abundance bin are NA and are ignored. Reads with fewer than two finite distances are omitted. The margin is an absolute difference on the algorithm's distance scale, not a probability.

Usage

ambiguous_reads(x, margin = 0.05)

Arguments

x

A MetabinResult object.

margin

Nonnegative maximum difference between the two smallest distances. Defaults to 0.05.

Value

A S4Vectors::DataFrame with read_id, bin, best_distance, second_distance, and distance_margin, in input order.

Examples

res <- composition_based_binning(
    system.file("extdata", "reads.metagenome.fasta.gz", package = "metabinR"),
    dryRun = TRUE, kMerSizeCB = 2, numOfClustersCB = 2
)
ambiguous_reads(res, margin = 0.05)
